# Project description

In this project we extracted the DNA of bulk soil without removing the roots (BR), bulk soil removing the roots (BS), rhizosphere (Rh), stolon endosphere (stolon), leaf endosphere (leaf), below ground leaf/stem (BG), stolonosphere (SP) of some endemic plants in the páramo Chingaza:

- Espeletia (BR, BS, Rh, stolon, leaf, BG, SP)
- Chusquea (BR, BS, Rh, root)
- Oritrophium (BR, BS, Rh, stolon)
- Racomitrium (BR, BS, AG, BG)
- Calamagrostis (root, Rh)
- Oreobolus (root, Rh)

These plants were found at different páramo altitudes that also showed different soil moisture levels. We want to determine the differences in the microbiome structure across species and across microenvironments within the species.

# QIIME2

### Read and filter metadata

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv("~/Documents/CouradeauLab/paramos/Rhizosphere/Amplicons/16S/metadata.csv") %>%
  select(-Description, -X260_280, -ng_ul_nanodrop, -qubit_ng_ul,
         -dilution_DNA_ul, -dilution_water,
         -forward.absolute.filepath, -reverse.absolute.filepath) %>%
  unite("Host_Part", Host_species:Shortened_description, remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Ecosite = case_when(
      Host_species == "Espeletia"     ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oritrophium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Racomitrium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Calamagrostis" ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Chusquea"      ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oreobolus"     ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Fine-grained compartments (used for initial UpSet analysis)
    Broad_Compartment_fine = case_when(
      Shortened_description == "BS"                          ~ "A_Bulk_Soil",
      Shortened_description == "BR"                          ~ "B_Root_Affected_Soil",
      Shortened_description %in% c("Rh", "SP")              ~ "C_Rhizosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("root", "stolon", "BG")  ~ "D_Endosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("leaf", "AG")            ~ "E_Aboveground",
      TRUE ~ Shortened_description
    ),
    Broad_Compartment_fine = factor(Broad_Compartment_fine,
      levels = c("A_Bulk_Soil", "B_Root_Affected_Soil", "C_Rhizosphere",
                 "D_Endosphere", "E_Aboveground")),
    # Merged compartments (BS + BR combined, used for all downstream analysis)
    Broad_Compartment = case_when(
      Shortened_description %in% c("BS", "BR")              ~ "Bulk_Soil",
      Shortened_description %in% c("Rh", "SP")              ~ "Rhizosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("root", "stolon", "BG")  ~ "Endosphere",
      Shortened_description %in% c("leaf", "AG")            ~ "Aboveground",
      TRUE ~ Shortened_description
    ),
    Broad_Compartment = factor(Broad_Compartment,
      levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere", "Aboveground"))
  )

write_tsv(metadata, "16S/metadata_updated.tsv")


metadata_all <- read.csv("~/Documents/CouradeauLab/paramos/Rhizosphere/Amplicons/16S/metadata.csv") %>%
  select(-Description, -X260_280, -ng_ul_nanodrop, -qubit_ng_ul,
         -dilution_DNA_ul, -dilution_water,
         -forward.absolute.filepath, -reverse.absolute.filepath) %>%
  unite("Host_Part", Host_species:Shortened_description, remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Ecosite = case_when(
      Host_species == "Espeletia"     ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oritrophium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Racomitrium"   ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Calamagrostis" ~ "Espeletia_ecosite_AND_Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Chusquea"      ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      Host_species == "Oreobolus"     ~ "Chusquea_ecosite",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Compartment_ = case_when(
      Shortened_description %in% c("BS", "BR")      ~ "Soil",
      Shortened_description == "Rh"                 ~ "Rhizosphere",
      Shortened_description == "SP"                  ~ "Stolonosphere",
      Shortened_description == "root"                 ~ "Endosphere",
      Shortened_description == "stolon"              ~ "StolonEndosphere",
      Shortened_description == "BG"              ~ "BelowGroundStem",
      Shortened_description == "leaf"              ~ "Leaf",
      Shortened_description == "AG"              ~ "Aboveground",
      TRUE ~ Shortened_description
    ))

write_tsv(metadata_all, "16S/metadata_ALL_updated.tsv")

```

### Import data and demultiplex sequences (QIIME2)

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime tools import \
  --type 'SampleData[PairedEndSequencesWithQuality]' \
  --input-path 16S/metadata.tsv \
  --output-path 16S/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qza \
  --input-format PairedEndFastqManifestPhred33V2

qiime demux summarize \
  --i-data 16S/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qza \
  --o-visualization 16S/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qzv

qiime metadata tabulate \
  --m-input-file 16S/metadata.tsv \
  --o-visualization 16S/qiime2output/metadata.qzv
```

### Quality control and feature table

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime dada2 denoise-paired \
  --i-demultiplexed-seqs 16S/qiime2output/paired-end-demux.qza \
  --p-trunc-len-f 280 \
  --p-trunc-len-r 260 \
  --p-trim-left-f 20 \
  --p-trim-left-r 20 \
  --p-n-threads 0 \
  --p-min-fold-parent-over-abundance 2 \
  --p-chimera-method pooled \
  --o-table 16S/qiime2output/table.qza \
  --o-representative-sequences 16S/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qza \
  --o-denoising-stats 16S/qiime2output/denoising-stats.qza
```

### Generate summaries

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
qiime feature-table summarize \
  --i-table 16S/qiime2output/table.qza \
  --o-visualization 16S/qiime2output/table.qzv \
  --m-sample-metadata-file 16S/metadata.tsv

qiime feature-table tabulate-seqs \
  --i-data 16S/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qza \
  --o-visualization 16S/qiime2output/rep-seqs.qzv

qiime metadata tabulate \
  --m-input-file 16S/qiime2output/denoising-stats.qza \
  --o-visualization 16S/qiime2output/denoising-stats.qzv
```

## Filter chloroplasts, mitochondria, and unassigned

```{r}
cat("ASVs before filtering:", ntaxa(physeq), "\n")

physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(physeq,
  !grepl("chloroplast", Class, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Class))
cat("ASVs after chloroplast removal:", ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "\n")

physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(physeq_filtered,
  !grepl("mitochondria", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Family))
cat("ASVs after mitochondria removal:", ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "\n")

physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(physeq_filtered,
  !is.na(Kingdom) & Kingdom != "" & !grepl("Unassigned", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat("ASVs after unassigned removal:", ntaxa(physeq_filtered), "\n")

#Silva

silva_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(silva_physeq,
  !grepl("chloroplast", Order, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Order))
cat("ASVs after chloroplast removal:", ntaxa(silva_physeq_filtered), "\n")

silva_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(silva_physeq_filtered,
  !grepl("mitochondria", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Family))
cat("ASVs after mitochondria removal:", ntaxa(silva_physeq_filtered), "\n")

silva_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(silva_physeq_filtered,
  !is.na(Kingdom) & Kingdom != "" & !grepl("Unassigned", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat("ASVs after unassigned removal:", ntaxa(silva_physeq_filtered), "\n")

#Silva ALL
cat("ASVs before filtering:", ntaxa(silva_ALL_physeq), "\n")

silva_ALL_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(silva_ALL_physeq,
  !grepl("chloroplast", Order, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Order))
cat("ASVs after chloroplast removal:", ntaxa(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered), "\n")

silva_ALL_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered,
  !grepl("mitochondria", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Family))
cat("ASVs after mitochondria removal:", ntaxa(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered), "\n")

silva_ALL_physeq_filtered <- subset_taxa(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered,
  !is.na(Kingdom) & Kingdom != "" & !grepl("Unassigned", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat("ASVs after unassigned removal:", ntaxa(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered), "\n")
```

After filtering chloroplasts, mitochondria, and unassigned. Some sample went from ~240K+ raw reads down to only 6,543 bacterial reads, meaning ~97% of its reads were contaminants (mostly plant mitochondrial DNA). Drop any sample below 10.000 reads and rarefy at the new minimum.

## Rarefaction curves

```{r rarefaction, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
rare_depth <- min(min(sample_sums(silva_physeq)), 239687)
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(silva_physeq), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(silva_physeq)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

set.seed(42)
rare_data <- rarecurve(otu_mat, step = 5000, tidy = TRUE)

sd_df <- as(sample_data(silva_physeq), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("Site")
rare_df <- rare_data %>%
  left_join(sd_df, by = "Site")

#ALL host parts
set.seed(42)
silva_ALL_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(
  prune_samples(sample_sums(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered) >= 10000, silva_ALL_physeq_filtered),
  sample.size = min(sample_sums(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered)[sample_sums(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered) >= 10000]),
  replace = FALSE, rngseed = 42
)

ggplot(rare_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site, color = Broad_Compartment)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rare_depth, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  labs(title = "Rarefaction Curves — By Compartment",
       x = "Sequencing Depth", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(rare_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site, color = Host_species)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rare_depth, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = host_pal) +
  labs(title = "Rarefaction Curves — By Host Species",
       x = "Sequencing Depth", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Core microbiome — Fine compartments (before merging)

We first check whether Bulk Soil (BS) and Root-Affected Soil (BR) share similar core taxa, justifying their merger.

## Core ASVs: fine compartments

```{r}
find_core <- function(ps, comp_name, comp_col = "Broad_Compartment_fine", prev_threshold = 0.5) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  keep_samples <- rownames(sd)[sd[[comp_col]] == comp_name]
  sub_ps <- prune_samples(keep_samples, ps)
  sub_ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sub_ps) > 0, sub_ps)
  otu <- as(otu_table(sub_ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(sub_ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  prevalence <- rowSums(otu > 0) / ncol(otu)
  return(names(prevalence[prevalence >= prev_threshold]))
}

fine_compartments <- c("A_Bulk_Soil", "B_Root_Affected_Soil", "C_Rhizosphere", "D_Endosphere")
core_fine <- setNames(
  lapply(fine_compartments, function(comp) find_core(silva_physeq_filtered, comp, "Broad_Compartment_fine")),
  fine_compartments
)

cat("Core ASVs per fine compartment (≥50% prevalence):\n")
sapply(core_fine, length)
```

## UpSet plot — Fine compartments (BS vs BR justification)

```{r}
upset(fromList(core_fine),
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = 4,
      sets.bar.color = unname(compartment_fine_pal[names(core_fine)]),
      main.bar.color = "grey30",
      text.scale = 1.3,
      point.size = 3,
      line.size = 1.2,
      mainbar.y.label = "Number of Shared Core ASVs",
      sets.x.label = "Core ASVs per Compartment")

ps_bs_br <- subset_samples(silva_physeq_filtered, Broad_Compartment_fine %in% c("A_Bulk_Soil", "B_Root_Affected_Soil"))
ps_bs_br <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_bs_br) > 0, ps_bs_br)

bray_bs_br <- phyloseq::distance(ps_bs_br, "bray")
meta_bs_br <- as(sample_data(ps_bs_br), "data.frame")

adonis2(bray_bs_br ~ Broad_Compartment_fine, data = meta_bs_br, permutations = 999)
```

Bulk Soil and Root-Affected Soil share the vast majority of core ASVs and were not significantly different by pairwise PERMANOVA (R² = 0.009, p = 0.996). We merge them as "Bulk_Soil" for all downstream analyses.

# Who is there — Taxonomic composition

All downstream analysis uses the merged compartments: Bulk_Soil, Rhizosphere, Endosphere, Aboveground.

## Phylum level

```{r, warning=FALSE}
physeq_phylum_rel <- silva_physeq_filtered %>%
  tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

plot_bar(physeq_phylum_rel, x = "Sample", fill = "Phylum") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(Ecosite ~ Host_species + Shortened_description,
             scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_pal) +
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

# Top 10 phyla + Other
top10_phyla <- psmelt(physeq_phylum_rel) %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

top10_pal <- setNames(
  c(brewer.pal(10, "Paired"), "grey70"),
  c(sort(top10_phyla), "Other")
)

df_top10 <- psmelt(physeq_phylum_rel) %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = ifelse(Phylum %in% top10_phyla, Phylum, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Phylum_grouped, Ecosite, Host_species, Shortened_description) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = factor(Phylum_grouped, levels = c(sort(top10_phyla), "Other")))

ggplot(df_top10, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(Ecosite ~ Host_species + Shortened_description,
             scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = top10_pal, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Phyla + Other", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

```

### Soil only

```{r}
# ── Soil-only composition: all soil samples pooled, one bar per sample ─────
ps_soil <- subset_samples(silva_ALL_physeq_filtered, Compartment_ == "Soil")
ps_soil <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_soil) > 0, ps_soil)

ps_soil_phy <- ps_soil %>%
  tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

df_soil <- psmelt(ps_soil_phy) %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = ifelse(Phylum %in% top10_phyla, Phylum, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Host_species, Phylum_grouped) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Phylum_grouped = factor(Phylum_grouped,
                                  levels = c(sort(top10_phyla), "Other")))

# Order samples by host species so host-related structure is visible
sample_order <- df_soil %>%
  distinct(Sample, Host_species) %>%
  arrange(Host_species, Sample) %>%
  pull(Sample)
df_soil <- df_soil %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order))

ggplot(df_soil,
       aes(x = Sample, y = RelAbundance, fill = Phylum_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Host_species, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = top10_pal, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(title = "16S Phylum Composition — Soil (BS + BR pooled across hosts)",
       subtitle = paste0(nsamples(ps_soil), " soil samples"),
       x = "", y = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave("16S_figures/16S_phylum_soil_only.pdf",
       width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
silva_physeq_genus <- tax_glom(silva_physeq_filtered, "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
silva_physeq_genus_rel <- transform_sample_counts(silva_physeq_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))

silva_top50_genera <- names(sort(taxa_sums(silva_physeq_genus_rel), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
silva_physeq_top50 <- prune_taxa(silva_top50_genera, silva_physeq_genus_rel)

silva_tax_top50 <- as.data.frame(tax_table(silva_physeq_top50))
silva_tax_top50$label <- paste0(
  ifelse(is.na(silva_tax_top50$Genus) | silva_tax_top50$Genus == "",
         paste0("Unc. ", silva_tax_top50$Family),
         silva_tax_top50$Genus),
  " (", silva_tax_top50$Phylum, ")"
)

silva_mat_genus <- as(otu_table(silva_physeq_top50), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(silva_physeq_top50)) silva_mat_genus <- t(silva_mat_genus)
rownames(silva_mat_genus) <- silva_tax_top50$label

silva_annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Compartment = sample_data(silva_physeq_top50)$Broad_Compartment,
  Host = sample_data(silva_physeq_top50)$Host_species,
  Ecosite = sample_data(silva_physeq_top50)$Ecosite,
  row.names = sample_names(silva_physeq_top50)
)

sample_order <- rownames(silva_annotation_col)[order(silva_annotation_col$Compartment, silva_annotation_col$Host)]
silva_mat_genus <- silva_mat_genus[, sample_order]
silva_annotation_col <- silva_annotation_col[sample_order, ]
comp_gaps <- cumsum(table(silva_annotation_col$Compartment))

ann_colors <- list(
  Compartment = compartment_pal,
  Host = host_pal,
  Ecosite = ecosite_pal
)

#Check to determine color scale
silva_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(silva_mat_genus)))
summary(as.vector(silva_mat_scaled))
range(silva_mat_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)

silva_color_breaks <- seq(-3, 5, length.out = 101)
silva_pheatmap <- pheatmap(silva_mat_genus,
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = silva_annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         gaps_col = comp_gaps,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         fontsize_row = 7,
         main = "Top 50 Genera (Ordered by Compartment × Host)",
         breaks = silva_color_breaks,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         border_color = NA)
print(silva_pheatmap)
```

# Alpha diversity

Calculated at ASV level so "Observed" reflects true richness.

```{r}
set.seed(42)
min_depth <- min(sample_sums(silva_physeq_filtered))
rare_depth <- min_depth
cat("Rarefying to:", rare_depth, "reads\n")

silva_physeq_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(silva_physeq_filtered, sample.size = rare_depth,
                                  replace = FALSE, rngseed = 42)

alpha_div <- estimate_richness(silva_physeq_rare, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed", "Chao1"))
alpha_div$Sample <- rownames(alpha_div)
alpha_meta <- cbind(alpha_div, as(sample_data(silva_physeq_rare), "data.frame"))

#ALL host parts

alpha_fine <- estimate_richness(silva_ALL_rare,
                                measures = c("Shannon","Observed","Chao1")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(as(sample_data(silva_ALL_rare), "data.frame") %>%
              rownames_to_column("Sample"), by = "Sample")

p_shan <- ggplot(alpha_fine, aes(Compartment_, Shannon, fill = Compartment_)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_fine_full_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~ Host_species, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  labs(title = "Shannon Diversity — Host × Fine Compartment",
       x = "", y = "Shannon Index") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.position = "none")

p_obs <- ggplot(alpha_fine, aes(Compartment_, Observed, fill = Compartment_)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_fine_full_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~ Host_species, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  labs(title = "Observed ASVs — Host × Fine Compartment",
       x = "", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.position = "none")

p_shan / p_obs

alpha_fine %>%
  group_by(Host_species) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Compartment_) >= 2) %>%
  summarize(
    Shannon_p  = if (n_distinct(Compartment_) >= 2)
                   kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Compartment_)$p.value else NA,
    Observed_p = if (n_distinct(Compartment_) >= 2)
                   kruskal.test(Observed ~ Compartment_)$p.value else NA,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_p"), ~p.adjust(., "BH"))) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4,
    caption = "Within-host Kruskal-Wallis: alpha diversity ~ fine compartment")

```

### Statistical tests

```{r}
kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Broad_Compartment, data = alpha_meta)
kruskal.test(Observed ~ Broad_Compartment, data = alpha_meta)
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_meta$Shannon, alpha_meta$Broad_Compartment, p.adjust.method = "BH")
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_meta$Observed, alpha_meta$Broad_Compartment, p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

```{r}
bray_dist <- phyloseq::distance(silva_physeq_rare, method = "bray")
pcoa_res <- ordinate(silva_physeq_rare, method = "PCoA", distance = bray_dist)

plot_ordination(silva_physeq_rare, pcoa_res, color = "Broad_Compartment", shape = "Host_species") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Broad_Compartment), linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) — By Compartment") +
  theme_minimal()

plot_ordination(silva_physeq_rare, pcoa_res, color = "Host_species", shape = "Broad_Compartment") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = host_pal) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Host_species), linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) — By Host Species") +
  theme_minimal()

# PCoA without Aboveground
silva_physeq_rare_noAG <- subset_samples(silva_physeq_rare, Broad_Compartment != "Aboveground")
silva_physeq_rare_noAG <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(silva_physeq_rare_noAG) > 0, silva_physeq_rare_noAG)

bray_noAG <- phyloseq::distance(silva_physeq_rare_noAG, method = "bray")
pcoa_noAG <- ordinate(silva_physeq_rare_noAG, method = "PCoA", distance = bray_noAG)

plot_ordination(silva_physeq_rare_noAG, pcoa_noAG, color = "Broad_Compartment", shape = "Host_species") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Broad_Compartment), linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) — By Compartment (excl. Aboveground)") +
  theme_minimal()

plot_ordination(silva_physeq_rare_noAG, pcoa_noAG, color = "Host_species", shape = "Broad_Compartment") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = host_pal) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Host_species), linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) — By Host Species (excl. Aboveground)") +
  theme_minimal()

## ALL host parts
bray_fine  <- phyloseq::distance(silva_ALL_rare, "bray")
pcoa_fine  <- ordinate(silva_ALL_rare, "PCoA", distance = bray_fine)
meta_fine  <- as(sample_data(silva_ALL_rare), "data.frame")

# Global view
g_global <- plot_ordination(silva_ALL_rare, pcoa_fine,
                color = "Compartment_", shape = "Host_species") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_fine_full_pal) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Compartment_), linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) — All samples colored by fine compartment") +
  theme_minimal()

# Per-host facets — same axes, easier to read recruitment per host
pcoa_df <- pcoa_fine$vectors[, 1:2] %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(meta_fine %>% rownames_to_column("Sample"), by = "Sample")

g_facet <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(Axis.1, Axis.2,
                               color = Compartment_, shape = Host_species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_fine_full_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~ Host_species, nrow = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Compartment_), linetype = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "PCoA — Per-host panels",
       x = paste0("Axis 1 (", round(100 * pcoa_fine$values$Relative_eig[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("Axis 2 (", round(100 * pcoa_fine$values$Relative_eig[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal()

g_global / g_facet
```

## PERMANOVA

```{r}
meta_df <- as(sample_data(silva_physeq_rare), "data.frame")
bray_rare <- phyloseq::distance(silva_physeq_rare, "bray")

cat("=== PERMANOVA: Broad_Compartment ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Broad_Compartment, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Host_species ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Host_species, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Ecosite ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Ecosite, data = meta_df, permutations = 999)

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Full Model ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Broad_Compartment + Host_species + Ecosite,
        data = meta_df, permutations = 999, by = "terms")

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA: Compartment × Host Interaction ===\n")
adonis2(bray_rare ~ Broad_Compartment * Host_species,
        data = meta_df, permutations = 999, by = "terms")

# ALL host parts
adonis2(bray_fine ~ Compartment_ + Host_species,
        data = meta_fine, permutations = 999, by = "terms")

adonis2(bray_fine ~ Compartment_ * Host_species,
        data = meta_fine, permutations = 999, by = "terms")

# Per-host PERMANOVA — what each host's compartments contribute on their own
per_host_perm <- lapply(levels(meta_fine$Host_species), function(h) {
  keep <- rownames(meta_fine)[meta_fine$Host_species == h]
  if (length(unique(meta_fine[keep, "Compartment_"])) < 2) return(NULL)
  ps_h <- prune_samples(keep, silva_ALL_rare)
  ps_h <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_h) > 0, ps_h)
  d <- phyloseq::distance(ps_h, "bray")
  m <- as(sample_data(ps_h), "data.frame")
  res <- adonis2(d ~ Compartment_, data = m, permutations = 999)
  data.frame(Host = h, R2 = res$R2[1], p = res$`Pr(>F)`[1])
}) %>% bind_rows()

per_host_perm$p_adj <- p.adjust(per_host_perm$p, method = "BH")
knitr::kable(per_host_perm, digits = 4,
             caption = "Per-host PERMANOVA: community ~ Compartment_")
```

### Pairwise PERMANOVA

```{r}
compartments <- unique(as.character(meta_df$Broad_Compartment))
compartments <- compartments[!is.na(compartments) & compartments != ""]
n_comp <- length(compartments)

pairwise_results <- data.frame(
  Comp1 = character(), Comp2 = character(),
  R2 = numeric(), p_value = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in 1:(n_comp - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):n_comp) {
    sub_samples <- rownames(meta_df)[meta_df$Broad_Compartment %in%
                                       c(compartments[i], compartments[j])]
    n_per_group <- table(meta_df[sub_samples, "Broad_Compartment"])
    n_per_group <- n_per_group[n_per_group > 0]
    if (length(n_per_group) < 2 || any(n_per_group < 2)) {
      cat("Skipping", compartments[i], "vs", compartments[j], "- insufficient samples\n")
      next
    }
    sub_physeq <- prune_samples(sub_samples, silva_physeq_rare)
    sub_physeq <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sub_physeq) > 0, sub_physeq)
    sub_dist <- phyloseq::distance(sub_physeq, "bray")
    sub_meta <- as(sample_data(sub_physeq), "data.frame")
    res <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ Broad_Compartment, data = sub_meta, permutations = 999)
    pairwise_results <- rbind(pairwise_results, data.frame(
      Comp1 = compartments[i], Comp2 = compartments[j],
      R2 = res$R2[1], p_value = res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
    ))
  }
}

pairwise_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value, method = "BH")
knitr::kable(pairwise_results, digits = 4,
             caption = "Pairwise PERMANOVA: Compartment Comparisons")
```

## Constrained ordination (dbRDA)

```{r}
# Compute the distance matrix
bray_all <- phyloseq::distance(silva_physeq_filtered, "bray")

# pull metadata into a regular data frame
meta_all <- as(sample_data(silva_physeq_filtered), "data.frame")

# fit the dbRDA model
cap <- capscale(bray_all ~ Broad_Compartment + Host_species, data = meta_all)

cat("=== ANOVA on dbRDA ===\n")
anova(cap, by = "terms")

site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cap, display = "sites"))
site_scores <- cbind(site_scores, meta_all)
bp_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(cap, display = "bp"))

dbRDA <-ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, color = Broad_Compartment, shape = Host_species),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  geom_segment(data = bp_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1 * 0.9, yend = CAP2 * 0.9),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(data = bp_scores,
                  aes(x = CAP1 * 0.95, y = CAP2 * 0.95,
                      label = rownames(bp_scores)), color = "black", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "dbRDA: Compartment + Host Species",
       x = paste0("CAP1 (", round(100 * cap$CCA$eig[1] / sum(cap$CCA$eig), 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("CAP2 (", round(100 * cap$CCA$eig[2] / sum(cap$CCA$eig), 1), "%)"),
       ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("16S_figures/dbRDA.pdf", dbRDA, width = 10, height = 8)
```

### Core genera

```{r}
physeq_genus_filt <- tax_glom(silva_physeq_filtered, "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

find_core_genus <- function(ps, comp_name, comp_col = "Broad_Compartment", prev_threshold = 0.5) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  keep_samples <- rownames(sd)[sd[[comp_col]] == comp_name]
  sub_ps <- prune_samples(keep_samples, ps)
  sub_ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sub_ps) > 0, sub_ps)
  otu <- as(otu_table(sub_ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(sub_ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  prevalence <- rowSums(otu > 0) / ncol(otu)
  core_otus <- names(prevalence[prevalence >= prev_threshold])
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(sub_ps))
  genus_names <- tax[core_otus, "Genus"]
  genus_names[is.na(genus_names)] <- paste0("Unc.", tax[core_otus[is.na(genus_names)], "Family"])
  return(setNames(core_otus, genus_names))
}

core_genus_merged <- setNames(
  lapply(merged_compartments, function(comp) find_core_genus(physeq_genus_filt, comp)),
  merged_compartments
)

genus_name_lists <- lapply(core_genus_merged, names)
cat("Core genera per compartment:\n")
sapply(genus_name_lists, length)

upset(fromList(genus_name_lists),
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = 4,
      sets.bar.color = unname(compartment_pal[names(genus_name_lists)]),
      main.bar.color = "grey30",
      text.scale = 1.3,
      mainbar.y.label = "Shared Core Genera",
      sets.x.label = "Core Genera per Compartment")
```

```{r ancombc-all}
  subset_samples(Broad_Compartment %in% merged_compartments) %>%
  tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ps_ancom <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ancom) > 0, ps_ancom)

# Helper: clean genus labels
# add_genus_labels <- function(ps) {
#   tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>% rownames_to_column("taxon")
#   tax_df$Genus_label <- case_when(
#     !is.na(tax_df$Genus) & tax_df$Genus != ""   ~ tax_df$Genus,
#     !is.na(tax_df$Family) & tax_df$Family != "" ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Family),
#     !is.na(tax_df$Order) & tax_df$Order != ""   ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Order),
#     TRUE ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Class)
#   )
#   return(tax_df)
# }
add_genus_labels <- function(ps) {
  tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>% rownames_to_column("taxon")
  tax_df$Genus_label <- case_when(
    !is.na(tax_df$Genus) & tax_df$Genus != "" & !grepl("uncultured", tax_df$Genus, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ tax_df$Genus,
    !is.na(tax_df$Family) & tax_df$Family != "" & !grepl("uncultured", tax_df$Family, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Family),
    !is.na(tax_df$Order) & tax_df$Order != "" & !grepl("uncultured", tax_df$Order, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Order),
    !is.na(tax_df$Class) & tax_df$Class != "" & !grepl("uncultured", tax_df$Class, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Class),
    !is.na(tax_df$Phylum) & tax_df$Phylum != "" 
      ~ paste0("Unc.", tax_df$Phylum),
    TRUE ~ paste0("Unc.taxon_", tax_df$taxon)
  )
  return(tax_df)
}

tax_ancom <- add_genus_labels(ps_ancom)

# Force Bulk_Soil as reference level
sample_data(ps_ancom)$Broad_Compartment <- relevel(
  factor(sample_data(ps_ancom)$Broad_Compartment),
  ref = "Bulk_Soil"
)

ancom_res <- ancombc2(
  data = ps_ancom,
  fix_formula = "Broad_Compartment",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  alpha = 0.05,
  group = "Broad_Compartment",
  global = TRUE
)

ancom_df <- ancom_res$res %>%
  left_join(tax_ancom %>% select(taxon, Phylum, Family, Genus, Genus_label), by = "taxon")

# Identify columns dynamically for each comparison vs Bulk_Soil
get_ancom_cols <- function(df, pattern) {
  lfc  <- grep(paste0("^lfc_.*", pattern, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  q    <- grep(paste0("^q_.*", pattern, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  diff <- grep(paste0("^diff_.*", pattern, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  diff <- diff[!grepl("robust", diff)]
  
  cat("Pattern:", pattern, "-> lfc:", lfc, "| q:", q, "| diff:", diff, "\n")
  
  list(lfc = lfc, q = q, diff = diff)
}

cols_rh   <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_df, "Rhizosphere")
cols_endo <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_df, "Endosphere")
cols_ag   <- get_ancom_cols(ancom_df, "Aboveground")

sig_rh   <- ancom_df %>% filter(.data[[cols_rh$diff]] == TRUE)
sig_endo <- ancom_df %>% filter(.data[[cols_endo$diff]] == TRUE)
sig_ag   <- ancom_df %>% filter(.data[[cols_ag$diff]] == TRUE)

cat("Significant genera vs Bulk_Soil:\n")
cat("  Rhizosphere:", nrow(sig_rh), "\n")
cat("  Endosphere:", nrow(sig_endo), "\n")
cat("  Aboveground:", nrow(sig_ag), "\n")
```

### Volcano plots — All comparisons vs Bulk Soil

```{r ancombc-volcanos, fig.width=16, fig.height=5}
both_sig <- ancom_df %>%
  filter(.data[[cols_rh$diff]] == TRUE | .data[[cols_endo$diff]] == TRUE |
         .data[[cols_ag$diff]] == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(lfc_rh   = all_of(cols_rh$lfc),
                lfc_endo = all_of(cols_endo$lfc),
                lfc_ag   = all_of(cols_ag$lfc))

make_ancom_volcano <- function(df, lfc_col, q_col, title_str, lfc_cut = 1) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::rename(lfc = all_of(lfc_col), q_val = all_of(q_col)) %>%
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
      q_val < 0.05 & lfc > lfc_cut  ~ "Enriched",
      q_val < 0.05 & lfc < -lfc_cut ~ "Depleted",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ))
  top_labels <- plot_df %>% filter(Significance != "NS") %>% arrange(q_val) %>% head(15)
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lfc, y = -log10(q_val), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "firebrick", "Depleted" = "steelblue", "NS" = "grey70")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_labels, aes(label = Genus_label),
                    size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20, color = "black") +
    labs(title = title_str, x = "log Fold Change", y = "-log10(q-value)") +
    theme_minimal()
}

av1 <- make_ancom_volcano(ancom_df, cols_rh$lfc, cols_rh$q, "Rhizosphere vs Bulk Soil")
av2 <- make_ancom_volcano(ancom_df, cols_endo$lfc, cols_endo$q, "Endosphere vs Bulk Soil")
av3 <- make_ancom_volcano(ancom_df, cols_ag$lfc, cols_ag$q, "Aboveground vs Bulk Soil")
av1 + av2 + av3
```

### Top differentially abundant genera

```{r ancombc-barplots, fig.height=10}
detach("package:dplyr", unload = TRUE)
library(dplyr)

make_top_bar <- function(df, lfc_col, q_col, diff_col, comp_name, n = 20) {
  top_df <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[diff_col]] == TRUE) %>%
    rename(lfc = all_of(lfc_col), q_val = all_of(q_col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>%
    head(n) %>%
    mutate(Direction = ifelse(lfc > 0, paste0("Enriched in ", comp_name),
                                        paste0("Depleted in ", comp_name)))
  ggplot(top_df, aes(x = reorder(Genus_label, lfc), y = lfc, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("firebrick", "steelblue"),
      c(paste0("Enriched in ", comp_name), paste0("Depleted in ", comp_name)))) +
    labs(title = paste(comp_name, "vs Bulk Soil"), x = "", y = "log Fold Change") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r ancombc-ecosite}
head(sig_eco[, c("Order", "lfc", "q_val")])
```


## Compartment centric comparison

```{r}
# ---- RHIZOSPHERE-CENTRIC ----
# Rh vs BS: already have (cols_rh from global model)
# Rh vs Endo: flip sign of Endo vs Rh
# Rh vs AG: need to run or flip sign of AG vs Rh

# Get taxa significant in at least one Rh comparison
sig_rh_all <- unique(c(sig_rh$taxon, sig_rh_endo$taxon, sig_rh_ag$taxon))

rh_centric <- ancom_df %>%
  filter(taxon %in% sig_rh_all) %>%
  rename(lfc_rh_vs_bs = all_of(cols_rh$lfc)) %>%
  left_join(
    ancom_rh_endo_df %>% 
      select(taxon, all_of(cols_re$lfc)) %>%
      rename(lfc_endo_vs_rh = all_of(cols_re$lfc)),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ancom_rh_ag_df %>%
      select(taxon, all_of(cols_ra$lfc)) %>%
      rename(lfc_ag_vs_rh = all_of(cols_ra$lfc)),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  # Flip signs so everything is FROM rhizosphere's perspective
  mutate(
    lfc_rh_vs_bs = lfc_rh_vs_bs,          # already Rh vs BS
    lfc_rh_vs_endo = -lfc_endo_vs_rh,     # flip: Rh vs Endo
    lfc_rh_vs_ag = -lfc_ag_vs_rh          # flip: Rh vs AG
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lfc_rh_vs_endo) | !is.na(lfc_rh_vs_ag)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("lfc_rh"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(mean_abs = (abs(lfc_rh_vs_bs) + abs(lfc_rh_vs_endo) + abs(lfc_rh_vs_ag)) / 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs)) %>%
  head(30) %>%
  mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(
    duplicated(Genus_label) | duplicated(Genus_label, fromLast = TRUE),
    paste0(Genus_label, " (", taxon, ")"),
    Genus_label
  ))

mat_rh <- rh_centric %>%
  select(Genus_label, lfc_rh_vs_bs, lfc_rh_vs_endo, lfc_rh_vs_ag) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genus_label") %>%
  as.matrix()
colnames(mat_rh) <- c("Rhizosphere\nvs Bulk Soil", 
                       "Rhizosphere\nvs Endosphere", 
                       "Rhizosphere\nvs Aboveground")

pheatmap(mat_rh,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         fontsize_row = 8,
         main = "Rhizosphere-Centric: What is enriched/depleted in Rhizosphere?",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         border_color = NA,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.1f",
         fontsize_number = 7)


# ---- ENDOSPHERE-CENTRIC ----
sig_endo_all <- unique(c(sig_endo$taxon, sig_rh_endo$taxon, sig_endo_ag$taxon))

endo_centric <- ancom_df %>%
  filter(taxon %in% sig_endo_all) %>%
  rename(lfc_endo_vs_bs = all_of(cols_endo$lfc)) %>%
  left_join(
    ancom_rh_endo_df %>%
      select(taxon, all_of(cols_re$lfc)) %>%
      rename(lfc_endo_vs_rh = all_of(cols_re$lfc)),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ancom_endo_ag_df %>%
      select(taxon, all_of(cols_ea$lfc)) %>%
      rename(lfc_ag_vs_endo = all_of(cols_ea$lfc)),
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lfc_endo_vs_bs = lfc_endo_vs_bs,        # already Endo vs BS
    lfc_endo_vs_rh = lfc_endo_vs_rh,        # already Endo vs Rh
    lfc_endo_vs_ag = -lfc_ag_vs_endo         # flip: Endo vs AG
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lfc_endo_vs_rh) | !is.na(lfc_endo_vs_ag)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("lfc_endo"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(mean_abs = (abs(lfc_endo_vs_bs) + abs(lfc_endo_vs_rh) + abs(lfc_endo_vs_ag)) / 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs)) %>%
  head(30) %>%
  mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(
    duplicated(Genus_label) | duplicated(Genus_label, fromLast = TRUE),

  ))

mat_endo <- endo_centric %>%
```

# Indicator species analysis

```{r indicator-species}
ps_indic <- silva_physeq_filtered %>%
  tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_data(.)$Broad_Compartment %in% merged_compartments, .)
ps_indic <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_indic) > 0, ps_indic)

otu_indic <- as(otu_table(ps_indic), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_indic)) otu_indic <- t(otu_indic)
otu_indic <- t(otu_indic)

groups <- as.character(sample_data(ps_indic)$Broad_Compartment)

set.seed(42)
indval_res <- multipatt(otu_indic, groups, func = "IndVal.g",
                        control = how(nperm = 999))

indval_summary <- indval_res$sign
indval_sig <- indval_summary[indval_summary$p.value < 0.05, ]

tax_indic <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_indic))
indval_sig$OTU <- rownames(indval_sig)
indval_sig <- indval_sig %>%
  left_join(tax_indic %>% rownames_to_column("OTU") %>%
              select(OTU, Phylum, Family, Genus), by = "OTU") %>%
  mutate(Genus_label = case_when(
    !is.na(Genus) & Genus != ""   ~ Genus,
    !is.na(Family) & Family != "" ~ paste0("Unc.", Family),
    TRUE ~ "Unc."
  ))

cat("Significant indicator genera:", nrow(indval_sig), "\n\n")

for (comp in merged_compartments) {
  col_name <- paste0("s.", comp)
  if (col_name %in% names(indval_sig)) {
    sub <- indval_sig %>% filter(.data[[col_name]] == 1) %>% arrange(p.value) %>% head(20)
    if (nrow(sub) > 0) {
      cat("--- Top indicators for", comp, "---\n")
      print(sub[, c("Genus_label", "Phylum", "stat", "p.value")])
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r per-plant-phylum, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
plants_with_gradient <- c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium",
                          "Racomitrium", "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus")

plant_plots <- lapply(plants_with_gradient, function(sp) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(silva_physeq_filtered), "data.frame")
  keep <- rownames(sd)[sd$Host_species == sp]
  sub <- prune_samples(keep, silva_physeq_filtered) %>%
    tax_glom("Phylum") %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)
  df <- psmelt(sub) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment)) %>%
    group_by(Broad_Compartment, Phylum) %>%
    summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
    mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Phylum)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_pal) +
    labs(title = sp, y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
})

wrap_plots(plant_plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Phylum Composition Along Gradient — Per Host") &
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
```

##ANCOM-BC2 per host

```{r}
run_host_ancom <- function(ps, host_name) {
  sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  keep <- rownames(sd)[sd$Host_species == host_name]
  ps_host <- prune_samples(keep, ps) %>%
    tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
  ps_host <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_host) > 0, ps_host)
  
  comp_counts <- table(sample_data(ps_host)$Broad_Compartment)
  comp_counts <- comp_counts[comp_counts >= 2]
  valid_comps <- names(comp_counts)
  
  if (length(valid_comps) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", host_name, "- fewer than 2 valid compartments\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Fix: avoid subset_samples NSE
  sd2 <- as(sample_data(ps_host), "data.frame")
  keep2 <- rownames(sd2)[sd2$Broad_Compartment %in% valid_comps]
  ps_host <- prune_samples(keep2, ps_host)
  ps_host <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_host) > 0, ps_host)
  
  ref <- ifelse("Bulk_Soil" %in% valid_comps, "Bulk_Soil", valid_comps[1])
  sample_data(ps_host)$Broad_Compartment <- relevel(
    factor(sample_data(ps_host)$Broad_Compartment), ref = ref
  )
  
  tax_df <- add_genus_labels(ps_host)
  
  res <- tryCatch(
    ancombc2(data = ps_host, fix_formula = "Broad_Compartment",
             p_adj_method = "BH", alpha = 0.05),
    error = function(e) { cat("Error for", host_name, ":", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )
  
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- res$res %>%
    left_join(tax_df %>% select(taxon, Phylum, Genus_label), by = "taxon")
  
  list(df = df, ref = ref, comps = valid_comps, host = host_name)
}

hosts <- c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium", "Racomitrium", 
           "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus")

host_ancom_results <- lapply(hosts, function(h) run_host_ancom(silva_physeq_filtered, h))
names(host_ancom_results) <- hosts
host_ancom_results <- host_ancom_results[!sapply(host_ancom_results, is.null)]
```

## Heatmaps per host

```{r}
make_host_heatmap <- function(res, n_top = 30) {
  df <- res$df
  ref <- res$ref
  comps <- setdiff(res$comps, ref)
  host <- res$host
  
  # Get LFC and diff columns for each comparison
  lfc_cols <- sapply(comps, function(comp) {
    grep(paste0("^lfc_.*", comp, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  })
  diff_cols <- sapply(comps, function(comp) {
    col <- grep(paste0("^diff_.*", comp, "$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
    col[!grepl("robust", col)]
  })
  
  # Filter to taxa significant in at least one comparison
  sig_filter <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(diff_cols, function(dc) df[[dc]] == TRUE))
  df_sig <- df[sig_filter, ]
  
  if (nrow(df_sig) == 0) {
    cat("No significant taxa for", host, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Build LFC matrix
  mat <- df_sig %>%
    select(Genus_label, all_of(unname(lfc_cols))) %>%
    mutate(mean_abs = rowMeans(abs(across(-Genus_label)))) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abs)) %>%
    head(n_top) %>%
    select(-mean_abs) %>%
    mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(
      duplicated(Genus_label) | duplicated(Genus_label, fromLast = TRUE),
      paste0(Genus_label, " (", row_number(), ")"),
      Genus_label
    )) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Genus_label") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Clean column names
  colnames(mat) <- gsub("lfc_Broad_Compartment", "", colnames(mat))
  colnames(mat) <- paste0(colnames(mat), "\nvs ", ref)
  
  pheatmap(mat,
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           fontsize_row = 8,
           main = paste0("ANCOM-BC2: ", host, " — Significant Genera Along Gradient"),
           color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
           border_color = NA,
           display_numbers = TRUE,
           number_format = "%.1f",
           fontsize_number = 7)
}


for (h in names(host_ancom_results)) {
  make_host_heatmap(host_ancom_results[[h]])
}
```

# FAPROTAX

## parse database

```{r}
# Parse FAPROTAX database
parse_faprotax <- function(lines) {
  groups <- list()
  current_group <- NULL
  for (line in lines) {
    line <- trimws(line)
    if (line == "" || startsWith(line, "#")) next
    if (!startsWith(line, "*")) {
      current_group <- gsub("\\s.*", "", line)
      groups[[current_group]] <- character(0)
    } else {
      member <- gsub("#.*", "", line)
      member <- trimws(member)
      groups[[current_group]] <- c(groups[[current_group]], member)
    }
  }
  groups
}

matches_pattern <- function(taxonomy, pattern) {
  regex <- pattern %>%
    gsub("\\*", ".*", .) %>%
    paste0("^", ., "$")
  grepl(regex, taxonomy, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

assign_functions <- function(tax_string, groups) {
  assigned <- character(0)
  for (group_name in names(groups)) {
    for (pattern in groups[[group_name]]) {
      if (matches_pattern(tax_string, pattern)) {
        assigned <- c(assigned, group_name)
        break
      }
    }
  }
  assigned
}

# Read and parse FAPROTAX database
faprotax_lines <- readLines("16S/FAPROTAX_1.2.12/FAPROTAX.txt")
faprotax_groups <- parse_faprotax(faprotax_lines)

# SILVA -> old name conversion (applied to merged$taxonomy before assignment)
name_map <- c(
  "Acidobacteriota" = "Acidobacteria", "Actinobacteriota" = "Actinobacteria",
  "Armatimonadota" = "Armatimonadetes", "Bacteroidota" = "Bacteroidetes",
  "Deinococcota" = "Deinococcus-Thermus", "Elusimicrobiota" = "Elusimicrobia",
  "Fibrobacterota" = "Fibrobacteres", "Fusobacteriota" = "Fusobacteria",
  "Gemmatimonadota" = "Gemmatimonadetes", "Myxococcota" = "Deltaproteobacteria",
  "Nitrospinota" = "Nitrospinae", "Nitrospirota" = "Nitrospirae",
  "Patescibacteria" = "Parcubacteria", "Planctomycetota" = "Planctomycetes",
  "Spirochaetota" = "Spirochaetes", "Thermoplasmatota" = "Thermoplasmata",
  "Verrucomicrobiota" = "Verrucomicrobia", "Halobacterota" = "Euryarchaeota"
)
```


```{r}
otu <- read.delim("16S/qiime2output/feature-table.tsv", skip = 1, check.names = FALSE)
tax <- read.delim("16S/qiime2output/exported-taxonomy-silva/taxonomy.tsv", check.names = FALSE)

merged <- merge(otu, tax[, c("#OTUID", "taxonomy")], by.x = "#OTU ID", by.y = "#OTUID")

# Add spaces after semicolons
merged$taxonomy <- gsub(";", "; ", merged$taxonomy)

# Check
head(merged$taxonomy, 3)

names(merged)[names(merged) == "#OTU ID"] <- "#OTU ID"
merged$taxonomy <- gsub("d__", "k__", merged$taxonomy)
head(merged$taxonomy, 3)

# Convert SILVA phylum names to match FAPROTAX
for (new_name in names(name_map)) {
  merged$taxonomy <- gsub(new_name, name_map[new_name], merged$taxonomy)
}

# Filter to silva_physeq_filtered ASVs
filtered_asvs <- taxa_names(silva_physeq_filtered)
merged <- merged[merged$`#OTU ID` %in% filtered_asvs, ]
cat("Filtered ASVs:", nrow(merged), "\n")

write.table(merged, file = "16S/qiime2output/faprotax_input.tsv",
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Read the OTU table
otu <- read.delim("16S/qiime2output/feature-table.tsv", skip = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Get filtered ASV IDs
filtered_asvs <- taxa_names(silva_physeq_filtered)

# Filter merged table
merged_filt <- merged[merged$`#OTU ID` %in% filtered_asvs, ]
cat("ASVs before:", nrow(merged), "After:", nrow(merged_filt), "\n")

# Redo the assignment on filtered data
merged <- merged_filt

# Assign functions to every ASV
cat("Assigning functions to", nrow(merged), "ASVs...\n")
asv_functions <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(merged)), function(i) {
  if (i %% 5000 == 0) cat("  ", i, "/", nrow(merged), "\n")
  assign_functions(merged$taxonomy[i], faprotax_groups)
})

# Count assignments
n_assigned <- sum(sapply(asv_functions, length) > 0)
cat("ASVs assigned to at least one function:", n_assigned, "out of", nrow(merged), "\n")

# Build functional abundance table
all_functions <- unique(unlist(asv_functions))
cat("Functions detected:", length(all_functions), "\n")

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(merged), c("#OTU ID", "taxonomy"))

func_table <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_functions), ncol = length(sample_cols),
                     dimnames = list(all_functions, sample_cols))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(merged))) {
  fns <- asv_functions[[i]]
  if (length(fns) > 0) {
    counts <- as.numeric(merged[i, sample_cols])
    for (fn in fns) {
      func_table[fn, ] <- func_table[fn, ] + counts
    }
  }
}

# func_df <- as.data.frame(func_table) %>% rownames_to_column("Function")
rownames(func_table) <- gsub("add_group:", "", rownames(func_table))
func_df <- as.data.frame(func_table) %>% rownames_to_column("Function")

write.csv(func_df, "16S/faprotax_functional_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Done! Functional table written.\n")
cat("\nTop 20 functions by total abundance:\n")
sort(rowSums(func_table), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
```

### Top functions along gradient
```{r}
func_df <- read.csv("16S/faprotax_functional_table.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Relative abundance of functions per compartment
func_meta <- func_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-Function, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(sample.id, Broad_Compartment, Host_species, Ecosite),
            by = c("Sample" = "sample.id"))

func_rel <- func_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment)) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, Function) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

top_functions <- func_rel %>%
  group_by(Function) %>%
  summarize(Total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Function)

func_rel_top <- func_rel %>%
  mutate(Function_grouped = ifelse(Function %in% top_functions, Function, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, Function_grouped) %>%
  summarize(RelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(func_rel_top, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Function_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(title = "FAPROTAX: Predicted Functions Along the Gradient",
       y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "", fill = "Function") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

#without aerobic_chemoheterotrophy
func_rel_top_filtered <- func_rel %>%
  filter(!Function %in% c("aerobic_chemoheterotrophy", "chemoheterotrophy")) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Function_grouped = ifelse(Function %in% top_functions & 
           !Function %in% c("aerobic_chemoheterotrophy", "chemoheterotrophy"), 
           Function, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, Function_grouped) %>%
  summarize(RelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(func_rel_top_filtered, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Function_grouped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(title = "FAPROTAX: Predicted Functions Along the Gradient\n(excluding aerobic chemoheterotrophy)",
       y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "", fill = "Function") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

#Focus on Biogeochemistry
key_functions <- c("knallgas_bacteria", "cellulolysis", "fermentation",
                   "aerobic_ammonia_oxidation", "aerobic_nitrite_oxidation",
                   "nitrogen_fixation", "methanotrophy", "sulfate_respiration",
                   "ureolysis", "hydrocarbon_degradation",
                   "aerobic_anoxygenic_phototrophy")
key_functions <- key_functions[key_functions %in% func_df$Function]

key_meta <- func_meta %>%
  filter(Function %in% key_functions, !is.na(Broad_Compartment)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / Total * 100)

ggplot(key_meta, aes(x = Broad_Compartment, y = RelAbundance, fill = Broad_Compartment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  facet_wrap(~ Function, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
  labs(title = "Key Biogeochemical Functions Along the Gradient",
       y = "Relative Abundance (%)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        legend.position = "none")

```

### Functions per compartment

```{r}
# Mean relative abundance per compartment
func_heatmap <- func_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(Broad_Compartment), Function %in% top_functions) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Broad_Compartment) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RelAbundance = Abundance / Total * 100) %>%
  group_by(Broad_Compartment, Function) %>%
  summarize(MeanRel = mean(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Broad_Compartment, values_from = MeanRel) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Function") %>%
  as.matrix()

pheatmap(func_heatmap,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         fontsize_row = 9,
         main = "FAPROTAX: Predicted Functional Profiles Along the Gradient",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         border_color = NA,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format = "%.1f",
         fontsize_number = 8)
```

### Predicted functions heatmap z-score scaled version
```{r}
func_host_mat <- func_host_heatmap_filtered %>%
  unite("Host_Comp", Host_species, Broad_Compartment, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Host_Comp, values_from = MeanRel, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Function") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create annotation for columns
ann_col <- data.frame(
  Host = gsub("_Bulk_Soil|_Rhizosphere|_Endosphere|_Aboveground", "", colnames(func_host_mat)),
  Compartment = gsub(".*_(?=Bulk_Soil|Rhizosphere|Endosphere|Aboveground)", "", 
                     colnames(func_host_mat), perl = TRUE),
  row.names = colnames(func_host_mat)
)

# Order columns by host then compartment
col_order <- rownames(ann_col)[order(ann_col$Host, 
  factor(ann_col$Compartment, levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere", "Aboveground")))]
func_host_mat <- func_host_mat[, col_order]
ann_col <- ann_col[col_order, ]

# Gaps between hosts
host_gaps <- cumsum(table(ann_col$Host))

ann_colors <- list(
  Compartment = compartment_pal,
  Host = host_pal
)

FAPROTAX_gradient <-pheatmap(func_host_mat,
         scale = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         gaps_col = host_gaps,
         fontsize_row = 8,
         fontsize_col = 6,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         main = "FAPROTAX: Predicted Functions — Host × Compartment",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
         border_color = NA)

ggsave("16S_figures/16S_FAPROTAX_gradient.pdf", FAPROTAX_gradient, width = 10, height = 8)
```

# Diversity in endosphere across host
In order to test the hypothesis that a more spacious endosphere can have more diverse microbes when comparing the pictures from the LAT.

```{r}
# Subset to endosphere only
ps_endo <- subset_samples(silva_physeq_rare, Broad_Compartment == "Endosphere")
ps_endo <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_endo) > 0, ps_endo)

# Check which hosts have endosphere samples
table(sample_data(ps_endo)$Host_species)

# Alpha diversity
alpha_endo <- estimate_richness(ps_endo, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed", "Chao1"))
alpha_endo$Sample <- rownames(alpha_endo)
alpha_endo <- cbind(alpha_endo, as(sample_data(ps_endo), "data.frame"))

# Boxplots
e1 <- ggplot(alpha_endo, aes(x = Host_species, y = Shannon, fill = Host_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_pal) +
  labs(title = "Endosphere Shannon Diversity by Host", x = "", y = "Shannon Index") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

e2 <- ggplot(alpha_endo, aes(x = Host_species, y = Observed, fill = Host_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_pal) +
  labs(title = "Endosphere ASV Richness by Host", x = "", y = "Observed ASVs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

e1 + e2

# Stats
kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Host_species, data = alpha_endo)
kruskal.test(Observed ~ Host_species, data = alpha_endo)
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_endo$Shannon, alpha_endo$Host_species, p.adjust.method = "BH")
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_endo$Observed, alpha_endo$Host_species, p.adjust.method = "BH")

```

# Run MaAsLin 3

```{r}
library(maaslin3)

ps_maaslin <- suppressMessages(
  silva_physeq_filtered %>%
    tax_glom("Genus", NArm = FALSE)
)
ps_maaslin <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_maaslin) > 0, ps_maaslin)

# Build genus labels
tax_maas <- add_genus_labels(ps_maaslin)
# Create a named vector: ASV hash -> Genus_label
# Handle duplicates by appending a number
label_vec <- tax_maas$Genus_label
dupes <- duplicated(label_vec) | duplicated(label_vec, fromLast = TRUE)
label_vec[dupes] <- paste0(label_vec[dupes], "_", seq_along(label_vec)[dupes])
names(label_vec) <- tax_maas$taxon

otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_maaslin), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_maaslin)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_mat)

# Rename columns from hashes to genus labels
colnames(otu_df) <- label_vec[colnames(otu_df)]

meta_maas <- as(sample_data(ps_maaslin), "data.frame")
meta_maas$Broad_Compartment <- factor(meta_maas$Broad_Compartment,
  levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere", "Aboveground"))
meta_maas$Host_species <- factor(meta_maas$Host_species,
  levels = c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium", "Racomitrium", "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus"))

maaslin_res <- maaslin3(
  input_data = otu_df,
  input_metadata = meta_maas,
  output = "16S/maaslin3_output",
  fixed_effects = c("Broad_Compartment", "Host_species"),
  reference = c("Broad_Compartment,Bulk_Soil", "Host_species,Espeletia"),
  normalization = "TSS",
  transform = "LOG",
  min_prevalence = 0.1,
  cores = 4
)
```

```{r}
# Subset to the three soil-plant compartments

ps_maaslin_soil <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_maaslin_soil) > 0, ps_maaslin_soil)

cat("After dropping Aboveground:\n")
cat("  Samples:", nsamples(ps_maaslin_soil), "\n")
cat("  Genera:", ntaxa(ps_maaslin_soil), "\n")

print(table(sample_data(ps_maaslin_soil)$Broad_Compartment))
cat("\nHost × Compartment design:\n")

           table(Host_species, Broad_Compartment)))

# Build genus labels (same approach as before)
tax_maas_soil <- add_genus_labels(ps_maaslin_soil)
label_vec <- tax_maas_soil$Genus_label
dupes <- duplicated(label_vec) | duplicated(label_vec, fromLast = TRUE)
label_vec[dupes] <- paste0(label_vec[dupes], "_", seq_along(label_vec)[dupes])
names(label_vec) <- tax_maas_soil$taxon

# Build input matrix (samples × features)
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_maaslin_soil), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_maaslin_soil)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_mat)
colnames(otu_df) <- label_vec[colnames(otu_df)]

# Metadata with reference levels and DROPPED Aboveground factor level
meta_maas_soil <- as(sample_data(ps_maaslin_soil), "data.frame")
meta_maas_soil$Broad_Compartment <- factor(
  meta_maas_soil$Broad_Compartment,
  levels = c("Bulk_Soil", "Rhizosphere", "Endosphere")
)
meta_maas_soil$Host_species <- factor(
  meta_maas_soil$Host_species,
  levels = c("Espeletia", "Chusquea", "Oritrophium",
             "Racomitrium", "Calamagrostis", "Oreobolus")
)

# Run MaAsLin 3 — separate output folder so you don't overwrite the 4-compartment results
maaslin_res_soil <- maaslin3(
  input_data       = otu_df,
  input_metadata   = meta_maas_soil,
  output           = "16S/maaslin3_output_soil_only",
  fixed_effects    = c("Broad_Compartment", "Host_species"),
  reference        = c("Broad_Compartment,Bulk_Soil",
                       "Host_species,Espeletia"),
  normalization    = "TSS",
  transform        = "LOG",
  min_prevalence   = 0.1,
  cores            = 4
)
```


# Export tables

```{r export}
write.csv(as.data.frame(otu_table(silva_physeq_filtered)), "16S/asv_table_filtered.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame(tax_table(silva_physeq_filtered)), "16S/taxonomy_table_filtered.csv")

# ANCOM-BC2 full results
write.csv(ancom_df, "16S/ANCOMBC2_compartment_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Core microbiome
core_summary <- lapply(names(core_merged), function(comp) {
  tax_all[core_merged[[comp]], ] %>%
    rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
    mutate(Compartment = comp)
}) %>% bind_rows()
write.csv(core_summary, "16S/core_microbiome_by_compartment.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Indicator species
write.csv(indval_sig, "16S/indicator_species_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("All tables exported to 16S/ directory\n")
```
